purpose: DEC-11's arm of Cov4's bounded regression: the subject-versus-mechanism boundary the user decided on 2026-08-20, plus the positive controls it must not cost.
relationship_to_cov4_challenge: ADDITIVE. evaluation/cov4_challenge.json is the frozen set the prompt experiment scored and is not modified; its 36 candidates and their counts stay exactly as committed. These cases are the ones that set does not contain.
labels_are_human: Every expected_fundable was assigned by reading the quoted source text in P7.3a and P7.3b, before any classifier call. No label derives from a model verdict -- §13's rule for DEC-11.
not_a_recogniser: Nothing here implements or tunes a recogniser. The production_span rows are what production returns today; the hand_extracted_real_document rows are candidates built at the document's own offsets for sets production rejects.
how_to_run: python tools/run_cov4_validation.py --cases evaluation/cov4_dec11_cases.json  (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; Claude Code strips it from tool subprocesses, so this runs in a human shell -- the same constraint §18.1 Cov4 and docs/FAMILY_TAXONOMY.md §3 already record)
required_result: every expected_fundable=yes row is accepted -- 0 false rejections on verified subject spans
every dec11_class=mechanism or delivery_pathway row is rejected
the exclusions_contaminant row is rejected WITHOUT costing the five subject rows in the same document (§6.4b, per-span filtering)
ownership verdicts unchanged: every row is owned by its own parent

candidates.title: (n) Public-Private Partnerships
candidates.excerpt: Public-private partnerships (PPPs) enable greater resources to be applied to help achieve technical goals and accelerate commercialization timelines. The rapidly growing private fusion sector is informed and enabled by decades of publicly supported research in fusion. Through PPPs, research can be pursued in a way that is relevant to the private sector and amenable to commercialization. Within the PPP space, multiple avenues exist for the public and private sector to cooperate on research of mutual interest. All activities in this space are contingent on future appropriations.
candidates.truth_evidence: Its own text: PPPs "enable greater resources to be applied to help achieve technical goals" and "multiple avenues exist for the public and private sector to cooperate on research of mutual interest". It hosts three separately-administered programmes -- INFUSE ("a unique application process"), the Milestone-Based Fusion Development Program (Other Transactions via Technology Investment Agreements) and Private Facilities Research -- so it is the route by which work is funded, not what the work is about. Selectable, and not a subject.
